text1: The Formasa class battlecarrier is in essence, an upsized legion. Sporting additional engines, improved flux-shield grid, and an enlarge pair of hangar bays at the cost of losing several overlapping armour belts. Formasas are among the first ships cobbled together by the Mauvan exile, being sourced from several legion wrecks dotting a barren moon likely following the XIV's odyssey or the AI wars. Modern Formasas are sourced from the Hegemony following a treaty allowing the purchase of legions in exchange for occasional convertion jobs and a port friendly to the Hegemony navy.

The Furia is a fast attack cruiser derived from the fury class, losing its plasma burn for a more sustained plasma jet fit for skirmishing across battle lines. Mauvan's reinvention and continued interest in the furia, funnily enough, sparked a debate among Tri-Tachyon executives. One swore that the Aurora already fulfilled the Furia's role effectively, while another argued that the Furia excells at leading destroyer squadrons beyond what the Aurora is capable of. In the end, everyone generally agreed that this debate is between the respective executive salesperson of the Aurora and Fury.

Often being nicknamed 'Omenfury', the Fauv is modified fury class fitted with an enlarged EMP emitter used to support cruisers and destroyers alike. Despite what critics may say, the Fauv's EMP emitter is more suited for supporting center formations where the extra range and damage could fry heavy fighters and torpedoes slung by dedicated fleet carriers.

The Onrush is a battleship cobbled together from Onslaught parts following the doctrine that speed, maneuverability, and efficiency is more important than raw firepower and bulk. Several massive structural changes significantly weaken the hull integrity of the Onrush and removed several flux capacitors within the central prow, however in exchange it wields a better shield system and a the reduced mass increases its relative mobility and reduces its fuel cost when traveling through hyperspace.

A custom made Alpha class fast battleship ordered by a self annointed "Free Merchant" during NCD's heyday. The Spectana is a fast battleship which excells in pushing a breakthrough past unsupported cruiser lines while protecting friendly cruiser lines from similar threats. The spectana herself was praised by her owner for safely deterring (and even destroying) chasing cruisers during a general retreat from a rival Free Merchant
